reason: A browser voice-to-text utility that adds microphone input to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI composer and inserts recognized speech into the current draft without automatic submission.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的消息输入框添加麦克风按钮，将浏览器语音识别结果写入当前草稿而不会自动发送。
summaries.en: Adds a microphone button to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI composer and inserts browser speech-recognition results into the current draft without automatically sending it.

capabilities: Adds a microphone button to the chat composer
Requests browser microphone permission for speech recognition
Uses the browser Web Speech API to convert speech into draft text
Updates the current draft without automatically submitting messages
